verdicts.reason: A is broken: the bottle has come off its cream circle, which now sits empty at the bottom-left and gets cut off at the edge. The bottle is tiny, everything is squeezed into a thin middle strip with large dead areas above and below, and the stray faint circle at the top-left reads as an accident. B puts the bottle back on its circle at a good size and keeps the headline, NEW badge and Try It button clearly readable. Its flaws: the bottle cap sticks out past the circle, the headline floats centred while the row below starts at the left, there is a lot of empty orange on the right, and the stray faint circle at the top-left is still there.
